name: Earth Wildfire Watcher
brief: Spot possible wildfires with a heat-sensing camera and send useful reports to people on Earth. Keep the satellite working through a simulated 3-year mission.

baseRequirements.text: Install a heat-sensing infrared camera to spot hot areas
Keep the spacecraft running for the full 3-year simulation

optionalRequirements.text: See through smoke with SAR radar
Maintain a nonnegative data downlink balance

name: Lunar South Pole Ice Scout
brief: Circle the Moon and map the south pole. Search for signs of ice in craters that never receive direct sunlight. A hydrogen reading is a clue—not proof of water ice.

baseRequirements.text: Install a neutron detector or ice-search radar to look for possible ice
Install a camera, radar, or laser altimeter to map the surface

name: Neptune Atmosphere Mission
brief: Send an imaginary Neptune orbiter with a one-use atmospheric probe. Cross deep space, photograph changing storms, and send probe measurements home. Neptune has no solid surface to land on.

baseRequirements.text: Install a visible-light camera for Neptune cloud pictures
Use a radioisotope generator (RTG) far from the Sun

optionalRequirements.text: Carry an autonomous flight computer for delayed communications
